verdict.rationale: Mastra documents automatic triggering via cron schedules on workflows and agents. Workflows can branch with `.branch()`, wait on API callbacks through suspend/resume, and be created dynamically by external systems. These cover time-based triggers and conditional logic inside code-defined workflows. There is no evidence of a declarative rules or event-trigger system that fires actions on arbitrary events; the PubSub mention only concerns streaming delivery. Missing for 10: event-based triggers such as webhooks or app events, a declarative rule definition layer, and independent hands-on corroboration of trigger automation.
